title: Đây có phải là điểm đón chính xác không?
englishTitle: Is this the correct pickup point?
pronunciation: Day co phai la diem don chinh xac khong
summary: For checking the exact pickup spot before you wait in the wrong place.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Pickup areas can be split by gate, curb, app lane, tour group, or hotel entrance.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the booking, app pin, or message and point to where you are standing.

phrases.vietnamese: Đây có phải là điểm đón chính xác không?
phrases.english: Is this the correct pickup point?
phrases.pronunciation: Day co phai la diem don chinh xac khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Đây có phải là asks is this; điểm đón means pickup point; chính xác means correct or exact.

breakdown.vietnamese: Đây có phải là điểm đón chính xác không?
breakdown.english: Is this the correct pickup point

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: If the answer sends you elsewhere, ask for the pickup point, entrance, driver, or nearest landmark.

phrases.vietnamese: Cho hỏi, đi tới đó thế nào?
phrases.english: Excuse me, how do I get there?
phrases.pronunciation: cho hoy dee toy doh theh nao

phrases.english: How long does it take on foot?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good before a Grab, shuttle, tour bus, airport pickup, or hotel-arranged car.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Do not wait on a guess if the curb is crowded. A small correction now can save a missed pickup.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Use pickup point, address, direction, meeting-point, or stop-here follow-ups if the location changes.
